description: This Swift source file defines a namespace (enum) 'GatewayRemoteConfig' with static methods and nested types to handle configuration details related to remote gateway transport, URLs, tokens, and URL normalization logic.

classes.name: TokenValue
classes.description: An enum representing possible token states: missing, plaintext string, or unsupported non-string.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Determines the transport type (direct or ssh) based on the provided root dictionary.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Retrieves and trims the URL string from the nested root dictionary, returning nil if invalid or empty.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Extracts and trims the token value from the nested root dictionary, returning a TokenValue enum.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Returns the plaintext token string if available, otherwise nil.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the gateway URL from the root dictionary.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Converts a raw URL string into its normalized string form if valid.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Returns a normalized URL object if the input string is a valid WebSocket URL with correct scheme and host, adding default port if necessary.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Provides default port numbers for ws and wss schemes if no port is specified.
